title.en: Attentive groomers but customer service disputes

text.en: Clients frequently praise individual groomers for their patience and warmth, particularly during mobile visits. However, several pet owners experienced frustrating disputes with management and front desk staff concerning unexpected policy changes, unresolved equipment damage, and unreturned phone calls following service errors.

title.en: Mixed feedback on coat styling outcomes

text.en: Many customers report tidy breed cuts, pleasant shampoos, and helpful de-shedding treatments that leave dogs smelling fresh. Conversely, multiple reviewers describe severe styling mistakes, including an unauthorised close shave on a long-haired dog, uneven trimming lines, and cuts concealed beneath decorative bandanas.

Most reviews emphasise compassionate care for nervous and senior pets during bathing and nail clipping. Pet owners appreciate that bathers take time to soothe fearful animals and handle large or skittish dogs patiently, though one client expressed distress after hearing a groomer reprimand their yelping puppy.

q.en: Does Pup Town Spaw offer self-service dog washing facilities?

a.en: Yes, clients note that the salon provides self-wash tubs equipped with towels, shampoo, blow dryers, and grooming sprays.

q.en: Is mobile pet grooming available from this provider?

a.en: Yes, several customers highlight booking in-home mobile grooming visits for both cats and dogs.

q.en: Are vaccination records required prior to pet appointments?

a.en: Recent feedback indicates staff require current vaccination documentation before administering services such as nail trims.

q.en: Does the salon accommodate walk-in visits for pet grooming?

a.en: Clients report occasional walk-in availability for quick services, though booking ahead is advisable.
